$comment: Decision 0019 implements Decision 0014 gate G5. This is the default Project Uppercut professional ruleset: no three-knockdown rule, no standing eight count, a mandatory count after knockdowns, and no saved-by-the-bell rescue. A bout under these rules ends because a fighter cannot continue, an authorized official stops it, or the cards decide it.
name: Project Uppercut Professional Rules

referee_stoppage.note: A referee may stop a bout on judgment. This project does not yet model that judgment, so a current bout going the distance must not be mistaken for proof that it could not have been stopped.

notes: Selected as the default by Decision 0014 and implemented by Decision 0019. Pre-ruleset stoppage figures must be rerun rather than reread.
